assumptions: All graphs and digraphs are finite and simple unless the statement explicitly says otherwise.

definitions.definition: For integers p≥2q>0, a map c:V(G)→Z_p such that the cyclic distance between colors of adjacent vertices is at least q.
A list assignment L with L(v)⊆Z_p and |L(v)|≥tq at every vertex.
The infimum of real t such that G is colorable from every t-(p,q)-list assignment for every pair p≥2q>0.

domain.description: Finite simple planar graphs with circular list colorings.

quantifiers.domain: real constants that upper-bound cch(G) for every finite simple planar graph G

statement.text: Determine the least real constant C such that every finite simple planar graph G has circular choice number cch(G) at most C.

title: Circular choosability of planar graphs
